titleA.text: Direction A · a Costume slot (costume is a category; the covered chips fall asleep)

titleB.text: Direction B · the Wardrobe Hook (costumes hang on their own rail; the outfit folds into a strip)

stickyA.text:
DIRECTION A · A Costume slot

What it is: 'costume' is one more category. A ninth slot chip (lilac, at the head of the tray) and a Costumes section at the top of the rack. Wearing one puts the covered chips to sleep (cream2, 'under' tag) and a hand line under Rosie says what waits. The preview modal, the stall tile and the visit nameplate all reuse today's parts.

Pillar: Collect (a showpiece that sits beside everything else you own). Connect lightly (the nameplate tag on a visit).

Changes vs today: constants/slots.ts (+costume slot, label, tint); ClosetView CAT_ORDER/CAT_LABEL (+Costumes first) and an asleep style on chips when a costume is on; ItemPreviewModal routes category costume to the stage; StallPig.stallSlot +case; a Tag on the visit nameplate.

Build: ~1.25 h UI. slots+labels 15m · asleep chips+hand line 25m · preview routing+cover line 15m · stall tile tag 15m · visit tag 10m · buffer 15m.

Copy: slot 'Costume'; tile corner 'costume' / stall 'full costume'; hand line 'Hollow Jack is on. Hat, Bow and Face wait underneath.'; toast 'Hollow Jack is off. Your hat and bow are back.'; preview 'Covers everything but her face and hooves. Your hat, bow and glasses stay put underneath.' No em dashes; prices are numerals.

stickyB.text:
DIRECTION B · The Wardrobe Hook

What it is: costumes live on their own hook, a lilac rail between the fitting room and the rack, with the suits hanging by name. Wearing one folds the covered chips into a 'tucked under' strip with 'Take it off'; the hook marks the one that's on. Trying on is a full-bleed fitting-room sheet (the B3 try-on the stall cut). The stall gets a costume band of wide cards; a friend visiting a costumed pig gets a 'Boo!' bubble (the provisional Spook).

Pillar: Collect (the hook makes 11 suits a set to fill) and Connect (Boo is the visit reaction the 2026-10-14 entry promised).

Changes vs today: new CostumeHook component in the Closet; a folded-strip state replacing four chips; a fitting-room sheet route; a stall band with a wide card; the visit bubble.

Build: ~2 h UI as drawn. hook rail 35m · folded strip 30m · fitting sheet 30m · stall band 20m · Boo bubble 15m. To land in 1.5 h: drop the Boo bubble and use the existing preview modal instead of the sheet (1.4 h).

Copy: kicker '★ dress-up'; strip 'Hat, Bow and Face / tucked under Count Snout'; button 'Take it off'; sheet 'Goes on over her whole outfit. Nothing comes off; it all waits on the hook until she changes back.'; toast 'Count Snout is back on the hook. Your hat and bow are back on.'

stickyRec.text:
RECOMMENDATION

Ship A for the 1.5 h window. It keeps the Closet's one rule (owned dresses Rosie, unowned previews), adds no new component, and the data layer already lands costume as a category. 'Asleep' chips with an 'under' tag teach the hide-but-keep rule in place, without a dialog.

B is the better home once a second season of suits exists: the hook makes the 11 read as a collection, and the strip is a cleaner answer than nine chips. Keep B's copy ('tucked under', 'Take it off') even if A ships.

Both: Rosie-only in v1 (the art is fitted to her); other pigs see the tile greyed with 'fits Rosie'. The cover rule is render-side: a worn costume hides head, bow, face, neck, held; tickle, aura and scene still show.
